title: DRDA: Yet more codepoints
description:
PKGNAM, PKGNAMCT, PKGNAMCSN, RTNSETSTT, and many others

Also parse UNICODEMGR and CCSIDMGR as containing CCSID values,
as they do. This eventually could be used to determine some
of the encoding of the other parameters (DDM parameters, not the
FD:OCA objects like the SQL statements, etc.).

Fix #12307
